scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:app && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc -p apps/bartleby/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vp build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp lint apps/bartleby --format unix && pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp fmt apps/bartleby --check
scripts.prepare:app: pnpm -C ../../packages/contracts run build && pnpm -C ../../packages/frontend run build:tokens && node ./scripts/sync-shell.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && cargo test --locked --manifest-path ../../packages/planner/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prepare:app && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc -p apps/bartleby/tsconfig.json --noEmit
